model_answer.rationale: NovaPay Digital Goods and its treasury account are linked to sanctioned entity Vortex Holdings Ltd via a shared device. The merchant also bypassed onboarding controls through an unauthorized waiver approved by an employee without sufficient clearance. A freeze request has been submitted for the merchant and its treasury account, excluding the shared device and collateral accounts.

queries.cypher:
MATCH (n:Entity {id: $id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[o:FLOWS_TO]->()
WITH n, count(o) AS sends_to
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)<-[i:FLOWS_TO]-()
WITH n, sends_to, count(i) AS receives_from
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[x:USED_DEVICE|LOGGED_FROM]-()
RETURN n {.*}, labels(n), sends_to, receives_from, count(x)

MATCH (x:Entity {id: $id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (x)-[:FLOWS_TO]->(o)
WITH x, count(DISTINCT o) AS fan_out
OPTIONAL MATCH (x)<-[:FLOWS_TO]-(i)
WITH x, fan_out, count(DISTINCT i) AS fan_in
OPTIONAL MATCH (x)-[:USED_DEVICE]->(:Device)<-[:USED_DEVICE]-(sd:Account)
WHERE sd <> x
WITH x, fan_out, fan_in, count(DISTINCT sd) AS shared_device
OPTIONAL MATCH (x)-[:LOGGED_FROM]->(:IP)<-[:LOGGED_FROM]-(si:Account)
WHERE si <> x
WITH x, fan_out, fan_in, shared_device, count(DISTINCT si) AS shared_ip
OPTIONAL MATCH (x)-[:FLOWS_TO]-(nb:Account)-[:USED_DEVICE]->(d:Device)<-[:USED_DEVICE]-(far:Account)
WHERE far <> nb AND far <> x
WITH x, fan_out, fan_in, shared_device, shared_ip, count(DISTINCT d) AS device_bridges
OPTIONAL MATCH (x)-[:FLOWS_TO]->(b)-[:FLOWS_TO]->(x)
RETURN fan_out, fan_in, shared_device, shared_ip, device_bridges, count(DISTINCT b)

MATCH (f:SemanticFact)-[:ABOUT]->(target:Entity {id: $id})
WHERE f.status IN ['CURRENT', 'STALE']
OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:DERIVED_FROM]->(ev:Entity)
WITH f, collect(ev.id) AS evidence_ids, collect(ev.topology_updated_at) AS evidence_ts
WITH f, evidence_ids, evidence_ts, any(x IN evidence_ts WHERE x > f.valid_from) AS is_stale
RETURN f.id, f.claim, f.verdict, f.valid_from, f.episode_id, evidence_ids,
       [i IN range(0, size(evidence_ids) - 1) WHERE evidence_ts[i] > f.valid_from | evidence_ids[i]],
       CASE WHEN is_stale THEN 'STALE' ELSE f.status END
ORDER BY f.valid_from DESC

MATCH (ep:Episode)-[:ABOUT]->(x:Entity {id: $id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (ep)-[:HAS_STEP]->(s:Step)
WITH ep, s ORDER BY s.seq
WITH ep, collect(s.tool) AS tools
RETURN ep.id, ep.created_at, ep.verdict, ep.answer_state, tools
ORDER BY ep.created_at DESC LIMIT 3

UNWIND $patterns AS name
MATCH (pt:PatternType {name: name})<-[:FOR_PATTERN]-(pb:Playbook)-[:FIRST_STEP]->(first:PlaybookStep)
MATCH path = (first)-[:NEXT*0..12]->(s:PlaybookStep)
WITH pt, pb, s, length(path) AS pos ORDER BY pos
RETURN pt.name, pb.id, collect([s.tool, s.default_args])

UNWIND $ids AS eid
MATCH (n:Entity {id: eid})
RETURN n.id, labels(n), coalesce(n.name, n.title, n.summary, n.address, n.os)

statements.text: NovaPay Digital Goods (merch-nova-pay) has an eligible route to sanctioned Vortex Holdings Ltd (acct-vortex-holdings) in 5 hops: merch-nova-pay → acct-nova-ops → dev-fp-8821 → acct-volkov-clearing → acct-baltic-trade → acct-vortex-holdings.
The route crosses shared device dev-fp-8821, used by acct-nova-ops and acct-volkov-clearing; that hop is an identity link, not a transfer.
It reaches flagged Headless Linux Chromium (dev-fp-8821) at depth 2.

Up to $132,000 could reach Vortex Holdings Ltd (acct-vortex-holdings) from merch-nova-pay, acct-nova-ops, acct-volkov-clearing and acct-baltic-trade (max flow over aggregated transfers: an upper bound that ignores timing).
NovaPay Digital Goods (merch-nova-pay) sits in a community of 4,404, too large to treat as a ring.
dec-waiver-77 waived device_attestation for NovaPay Digital Goods (merch-nova-pay), approved by Rohan Mehta (emp-rohan-mehta) with L2 clearance (sources: tick-risk-408 and msg-slack-9921).
That breaks pol-aml-sec-4: emp-rohan-mehta (L2) approved a waiver for a merchant processing $410,000/month; pol-aml-sec-4 requires L3 above $250,000/month.
emp-rohan-mehta also approved dec-waiver-81 for Lumen Games Studio (merch-lumen-games), within policy.
A blanket block would also hit Volkov Clearing LLC (acct-volkov-clearing), a standard account moving $220,000/month through shared dev-fp-8821, so dev-fp-8821 should stay open.
Freeze request apr-bb9e3c00 for 2 accounts is waiting for Priya Nair (emp-priya-nair, L3) to sign off under pol-aml-sec-4; nothing is frozen yet.
